blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: 3D part assembly aims to reconstruct a complete shape from a set of unassembled parts by predicting a rigid SE(3) transformation for each part. Because the placement of a part is rarely determined by its own geometry, the task demands reasoning over the entire part set, and existing methods, which rely on pairwise relations or iterative generation and verification, scale poorly to objects with many parts. We present LLM2R, which casts part assembly as sequence modeling with a pretrained decoder-only large language model (LLM): a Point-BERT encoder and a Q-Former compress each part into a block of geometric tokens, the blocks of all parts are concatenated, and a causal LLM adapted with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) processes the sequence in one forward pass. Causal attention, however, lets the hidden states of a part observe only the parts that precede it. LLM2R therefore appends a block of learnable summary tokens after the last part: these tokens follow every part, so their states aggregate the whole assembly at a constant token cost, and a part-aware pose head fuses each part's states with them before predicting its rotation and translation. One architecture thus handles semantic and geometric assembly and predicts all poses in a single non-autoregressive pass. LLM2R achieves the highest part accuracy and success rate on all three PartNet categories, the best rotation error, translation error, and part accuracy on PartNeXt, and the lowest translation error and fastest inference on Breaking Bad, where only a fracture-specialized method is more accurate. Its advantage grows with the number of parts: at 100 parts it exceeds GARF by 33.5 points in part accuracy on Breaking Bad and Assembler by 29.1 points on PartNet, and it transfers zero-shot to unseen categories with more than 16 points higher part accuracy than the strongest of three baselines.
blocks.zh: 3D部分组装旨在通过预测每个部分的刚性SE(3)变换来从一组未组装的部分中重建出完整的形状. 由于一个部分的位置很少由它自己的几何来决定,所以任务需要对整个部分集进行推理,而现有的方法依赖于对等关系或迭代生成和验证,对多部分的物体的尺度差. 我们提出LLM2R,它将部分组装作为序列建模,采用预先训练的解码器唯一的大语言模型(LLM):一个Point-BERT编码器和一个Q-Former压缩器将每个部分压缩成一块几何符号,所有部分的块被调和,一个由Low-Rank Adaptation(LORA)所适应的因果LLLM在一个前行处理序列. 然而,由于引起注意,让一部分的隐藏状态只观察它之前的部分. 因此LLM2R在后半部分后附加了一组可学习的汇总符号:这些符号跟随了每个部分,所以它们的状态以恒定的符号成本将整组集合起来,一个部分意识在预测其自转和翻译之前会将每个部分的状态与它们组合在一起. 因此,一个架构处理语义和几何组装,并预测在单个非自回传中的所有外形. LLM2R在所有三个PartNet类别上都实现了最高的部分精度和成功率,在PartNeXt上实现了最佳旋转出错,翻译出错和部分精度,在Breaking Bad上实现了最低的翻译出错和最快的推论,只有断裂专用方法更准确. 它的优势随着零件数量的增长而增加:在100个零件上,它在Breaking Bad和Assembler上部分精确度超过GARF33.5分29.1分,在PartNet上将零射入不可见的分类中,比三个基线中最强的部分精度高出16分以上.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: When humans are presented with the scattered components of a disassembled object, such as furniture parts, archaeological fragments, or shattered everyday items, they can often infer the target structure and a spatially consistent arrangement of every component from local geometric cues and structural priors. This capacity is a hallmark of spatial intelligence ( Lu et al., 2025b ) , and computationally it manifests as the 3D part assembly problem : given a set of unassembled parts, predict the SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) rigid transformation of each part that reconstructs the complete shape. The task is relevant to manufacturing, robotics, archaeology, and restoration, often without a CAD model or template, so a consistent configuration must be inferred from the part geometry alone. What makes it hard is that the placement of a part is rarely determined by the part itself; every pose depends on the whole set.
blocks.zh: 当人类被呈现出一个被拆散的物体的散落部分,如家具零件,考古碎片,或者碎裂的日常物品时,他们常常可以推断出目标结构以及从局部几何提示和结构前缀中得出每个部件的空间一致性安排. 这种能力是空间智能的标志(Lu et al., 2025b),在计算上表现为3D部分组装问题:给一组未组装的部分,预测重建完整形状的每个部分的SE QQ(3)\mathrm{SE}(3)刚性转换. 这项任务与制造,机器人,考古学,修复有关,往往没有CAD模型或模板,所以必须仅从部分几何学中推断出一致的配置. 造成困难的是,某一部分的位置很少由该部分本身决定;每个姿势都取决于整个组合.

blocks.en: Existing methods exhibit three persistent limitations ( Huang et al., 2020 ; Zhang et al., 2022 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . First, most approaches model inter-part relationships through pairwise matching or local compatibility scores, which makes it difficult to capture higher-order constraints and to enforce global consistency across all parts ( Lee et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) . Second, many methods depend on auxiliary cues such as reference images, CAD templates, or category-specific priors that are unavailable in open-domain settings ( Li et al., 2020b ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Lu et al., 2025a ) . Third, they scale poorly with the part count: long-range dependencies among many components are hard to model without long-context support, and the cost of iterative candidate generation and verification grows rapidly ( Narayan et al., 2022 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 现有方法显示出三个持续存在的局限性 (黄等,2020年;张等,2022年;杜等,2024年;李等,2024年;王等,2025年b). 首先,大多数方法都通过对偶匹配或局部兼容分数来模拟段间关系,这使得难以捕捉到更高顺序的制约,并在各个部分实施全球一致性(Lee等人,2024年;Lee等人,2025年;Wu等人,2023年). 其次,许多方法取决于参考图像、CAD模板或开放域环境中无法使用的类别前缀等辅助提示(Li等人,2020年b;Zhang等人,2025年a;Lu等人,2025年a)。 第三,它们与部分计数的尺度差:许多组件之间的长期依赖性在没有长文本支持的情况下很难建模,迭代候选人生成和验证的成本迅速增长(Narayan等人,2022年;徐等人,2025年;赵等人,2025年;张等人,2024年).

blocks.en: Our starting point is that this is a sequence modeling problem of the kind that decoder-only large language models (LLMs) already solve at scale: every output must be consistent with a long context of tokens, and pretrained decoders bring long-context attention, efficient key-value caching, and weights that can be adapted with few trainable parameters. We therefore propose LLM2R , which treats each part as a block of geometric tokens, produced by a Point-BERT encoder ( Yu et al., 2022 ) and a Q-Former ( Li et al., 2023 ) , concatenates the blocks of all parts, and processes the sequence with a pretrained decoder-only LLM ( Yang et al., 2025a ) adapted through Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . The input is point clouds only, without images, templates, or category-specific priors, and the same architecture handles semantic part assembly and geometric fractured reassembly.
blocks.zh: 我们的出发点是,这是一个序列模型问题,这种序列模型已经解决了规模上只有解码器的大型语言模型(LLMs):每个输出都必须符合长时间的符号上下文,经过预先训练的解码器会带来长文本的注意,高效的密钥值缓存,以及能够用很少的可训练参数调整的重量. 因此,我们提议LLM2R将每个部分作为几何符号块,由Point-BERT编码器(Yu等人,2022年)和一个Q-Former(Li等人,2023年)生产,将各个部分的区块进行调整,并通过Low-Rank适应器(LORA)(Hu等人,2022年)进行预试解码器唯一的LLM(Yang等人,2025a年)处理序列. 输入仅是点云,没有图像,模板,或类别特定前缀,同一架构处理语义部分组装和几何断裂重组装.

blocks.en: A decoder-only LLM is causal, so the hidden states of the i i -th part attend to the instruction and to parts 1 , … , i 1,\ldots,i but not to the parts that follow: a pose read from a part’s own tokens would place the first leg of a chair without having seen the seat or the other legs. Rather than altering the attention mask, so that the pretrained decoder is reused unchanged, LLM2R appends a block of S S learnable summary tokens after the last part. These tokens follow every part, so their contextual states are computed with access to the complete assembly, once per object, within the same forward pass, and at a cost that is constant in the number of parts. A part-aware pose head then fuses the hidden states of each part with the summary states and regresses its rotation and translation, so that all poses are predicted in parallel from one pass over the sequence.
blocks.zh: 只有解码器的LLM是因果,因此i -th部分的隐藏状态关注指令和第一部分,...,i 1,\ldots,i但不关注接下来的部分:从某个部分自己的标志读到的姿势会将椅子的第一腿放在没有看到座位或其他腿的地方. LLM2R 与其改变注意面罩,使预训解码器的再利用不变,不如在最后一部分之后附加一个块S可学习的汇总符号. 这些符号跟随每个部分,所以它们的上下文状态是通过访问完整组装来计算的,每个对象一次,在同一前传中,成本不变的零件数量. 一个部分意识的姿势,然后将每个部分的隐藏状态与摘要状态相连接,并倒退它的旋转和翻译,这样,所有姿势都会从一个经过顺序的瞬间平行地预测出来.

blocks.en: We evaluate LLM2R on PartNet ( Mo et al., 2019 ) , Breaking Bad ( Sellán et al., 2022 ) , and the recently released PartNeXt benchmark ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , covering both semantic and geometric assembly, and study zero-shot transfer to unseen categories, scaling with the number of parts, and the contribution of each component. Our contributions are as follows. • We cast 3D part assembly as causal sequence modeling over geometric part tokens and adapt a pretrained decoder-only LLM to it with LoRA, yielding a single point-cloud-only framework for semantic and geometric assembly that predicts all poses in one non-autoregressive pass. • We introduce a block of learnable summary tokens and a part–summary fusion head that condition every pose on the whole assembly at a constant token cost without modifying the causal decoder; ablations identify the summary block as the component that matters most for part accuracy. • LLM2R achieves the best part accuracy on PartNet and PartNeXt and the lowest translation error and inference time on Breaking Bad. Its advantage grows with the part count, reaching 33.5 and 29.1 part-accuracy points over GARF and Assembler at 100 parts, and it transfers zero-shot to unseen categories with more than 16 points higher part accuracy than the strongest of three baselines. To our knowledge, LLM2R is the first method to adapt a pretrained decoder-only LLM to direct SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) pose prediction for 3D part assembly.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Semantic part assembly predicts the poses of annotated parts by modeling inter-part relations and refining configurations iteratively ( Huang et al., 2020 ; Narayan et al., 2022 ) ; this line has evolved toward sequence-aware formulations ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , hierarchical formulations such as 3DHPA ( Du et al., 2024 ) and CFPA ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , and distribution learning via diffusion-style processes that sample multiple plausible assemblies and support variable part counts ( Cheng et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) . Geometric fractured reassembly targets unlabeled fragments for which fracture-interface complementarity is central. Benchmarks ( Sellán et al., 2022 ) have catalyzed agglomerative denoise-and-verify pipelines ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) -equivariant representations ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , explicit matching of surface similarity and volumetric complementarity ( Lee et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2024 ) , flow- and diffusion-based shape priors ( Scarpellini et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ) , and generation-assisted formulations such as CRAG ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . BrickGPT applies autoregressive language modeling to brick-based construction ( Pun et al., 2025 ) rather than to the reassembly of given parts. LLM2R instead processes all parts in a single pass of a long-context LLM and conditions each pose on a learned summary of the whole assembly.
blocks.zh: 语义部分组装通过模拟段间关系和精细配置反复预测注释部分的姿势(Huang等人,2020年;Narayan等人,2022年);这条线已演变为有序列的配体(徐等人,2025年),分级配体,如3DHPA(Du等人,2024年)和CFPA(Zhang等人,2025年b年b年),并通过扩散式过程进行分配学习,对多种可能组件进行抽样,支持可变部分计数(Cheng等人,2023年;Zhao等人,2025年)。 几何断裂重新组装的目标未贴标签的碎片,其断裂界面互补是中心. 基准(Sellán等人,2022年)催化了高血压的脱氧核糖核酸管道(Wang等人,2025年b),SE →(3)\mathrm{SE}(3)-等离子表示(Wu等人,2023年),表面相似性和体积互补性的明确匹配(Lee等人,2025年;Lee等人,2024年),流体和扩散型的前身(Scarpellini等人,2024年;Lu等人,2025年a年); Li等人,2025年;Sun等人,2025年),以及CRAG(Jiang等人,2026年)等生成辅助制剂. BrickGPT对砖基建筑(Pun等人,2025年)采用自递式语言模型,而不是对特定部件进行重新组装. LLM2R转而以长文LLM的单传处理所有部分,条件各以整个组装的学习总结为条件.

blocks.en: A growing body of work encodes point clouds into tokens that are concatenated with text so that a decoder-only LLM acquires 3D-oriented dialogue and reasoning capabilities. PointLLM ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , Point-Bind ( Guo et al., 2023 ) , ShapeLLM ( Qi et al., 2024 ) , and ShapeLLM-Omni ( Ye et al., 2025 ) address object-level description, question answering, and interaction, while 3D-LLM ( Hong et al., 2023 ) , Chat-3D ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , LSceneLLM ( Zhi et al., 2025 ) , and MiniGPT-3D ( Tang et al., 2024 ) extend the interface to scenes. These methods generate free-form text; LLM2R instead uses a causal LLM ( Yang et al., 2025a ) to predict per-part SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) transformations and equips it with a summary block so that each prediction can depend on the entire part set.
blocks.zh: 越来越多的工作体编码将云点成符号,与文本相配合,这样只有解码器的LLM可以获得面向3D的对话和推理能力. PointLLM(徐等人,2024年),Point-Bind (Guo等人,2023年),ShapeLLM. (Qi等人,2024年),和ShapeLLM-Omni(Ye等人,2025年)讨论对象级描述,问答,互动,而3D-LLM(Hong等人,2023年),Chat-3D (Wang等人,2023)., LSceneLLM. (Zhi等人,2025年),和MiniGPT-3D(Tang等人,2024年)将界面扩展到场景. 这些方法生成自由形式文本;LLM2R转而使用因果LLM(Yang等人,2025a)来预测每段SE QQ(3)\mathrm{SE}(3)的变换,并装备一个摘要块,以便每个预测可以依赖于整个部分集.

blocks.en: Decoder-only language models have also been adapted to tasks whose outputs are not text. Frozen pretrained Transformers transfer to sequence tasks in other modalities when only a small fraction of their parameters is trained ( Lu et al., 2022 ) ; vision-language-action models such as RT-2 ( Brohan et al., 2023 ) and OpenVLA ( Kim et al., 2024 ) fine-tune a pretrained vision-language model to emit robot actions discretized into tokens; and ChatPose ( Feng et al., 2024 ) regresses 3D human pose parameters from the hidden state of a dedicated token. LLM2R follows this line in reusing a pretrained causal decoder with LoRA, but it reads out continuous SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) poses for a variable number of parts in one pass, each conditioned on summary states of the whole input sequence.
blocks.zh: 还根据产出不是文本的任务调整了只有解码器的语言模型。 当只有一小部分参数经过训练时(Lu等人,2022年);视觉语言动作模型,如RT-2(Brohan等人,2023年)和OpenVLA(Kim等人,2024年)微调一个预先经过训练的视觉语言模型,将机器人动作盘片化成符牌;以及ChatPose(Feng等人,2024年)将3D人姿势参数从一个专用符牌的隐藏状态退后. LLM2R遵循这条线与LORA重用预先训练的因果解码器,但它会读出连续的SE QQ(3)\mathrm{SE}(3)在一个通道中为多个可变的部件组成,每个部件都以整个输入序列的汇总状态为条件.

blocks.en: Content-free tokens that provide extra positions for computation or aggregation appear as global tokens in sparse attention ( Zaheer et al., 2020 ) , memory tokens ( Burtsev et al., 2020 ) , registers in vision Transformers ( Darcet et al., 2024 ) , and latent queries in Perceiver ( Jaegle et al., 2021 ) and the Q-Former of BLIP-2 ( Li et al., 2023 ) . The summary block of LLM2R differs in placement and use. It is appended after all inputs of a causal decoder, so its states summarize the complete part sequence, and these states are fused position-wise with each part’s states inside the pose head rather than consumed by a language model.
blocks.zh: 为计算或汇总提供额外位置的无内容标志作为全球标志出现在很少的注意(Zaheer等人,2020年),内存标志(Burtsev等人,2020年),视觉变形器登记(Darcet等人,2024年),以及Perceiver(Jaegle等人,2021年)和BLIP-2的Q-Former(Li等人,2023年)中。 LLM2R的概要块在放置和使用上有所不同. 它在因果解码器的所有输入后被附加,因此它的状态总结了完整的部分序列,这些状态与每个部分的状态在姿势头部结合,而不是被一种语言模型所消耗.

blocks.en: PointNet and its successors process unordered point sets with shared MLPs, symmetric aggregation, hierarchical grouping, dynamic graphs, point convolutions, or point-cloud self-attention ( Qi et al., 2017a ; Qi et al., 2017b ; Wang et al., 2019 ; Thomas et al., 2019 ; Zhao et al., 2021 ) , and self-supervised pretraining by contrastive learning ( Xie et al., 2020 ) or masked point modeling ( Yu et al., 2022 ; Pang et al., 2023 ) yields transferable representations. We adopt a pretrained Point-BERT encoder and learn a Q-Former that compresses its patch features into a fixed number of tokens in the language model’s embedding space.
blocks.zh: PointNet及其继任者用共享的MLP,对称聚合,分级组合,动态图表,点演化,或点云自觉处理无序点集(Qi等人,2017a; Qi等人, 2017b; Wang等人, 2019; Thomas等人, 2019; Zhao等人, 2021), 和通过对比性学习进行自我监督的预训(Xie等人, 2020年)或蒙面点模型(Yu等人, 2022年; Pang等人, 2023年)产生可转移的表示. 我们采用一个预先训练的 Point-BERT 编码器, 并学习一个 Q-Former, 将它的补丁特性压缩成语言模型嵌入空间中的固定数个符号 。

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: LLM2R takes a set of unassembled part point clouds as input and predicts a rigid SE ⁡ ( 3 ) \mathrm{SE}(3) transformation for each part that places it in the assembled shape (Figure 1 ).

blocks.en: Each part is encoded independently by a pretrained Point-BERT encoder Φ \Phi ( Yu et al., 2022 ) , which partitions P i P_{i} into G G local neighborhoods by farthest point sampling and k k -nearest-neighbor grouping, embeds each neighborhood with a small point network, and processes the resulting patch tokens with a Transformer. We use its patch-level output, one C C -dimensional descriptor per neighborhood, F i = Φ ⁡ ( P i ) ∈ ℝ G × C F_{i}=\Phi(P_{i})\in\mathbb{R}^{G\times C} . The encoder is initialized from masked point modeling on ShapeNet and kept frozen for most of training (Section 4.1 ); G = 64 G=64 , each neighborhood contains 32 points, and C = 8192 C=8192 is the size of the discrete point vocabulary of Point-BERT, whose logits form the patch descriptor.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate on three benchmarks and, for each, adopt the training and evaluation protocol of the strongest published baseline, so that the reported numbers are directly comparable. Breaking Bad ( Sellán et al., 2022 ) defines components as irregular fragments produced by physically simulated fracture and thus poses a geometric reassembly problem without semantic annotation. Following GARF ( Li et al., 2025 ) , we train one model on all Breaking Bad subsets and evaluate it on the volume-constrained Everyday (7,872 assemblies) and Artifact (3,697 assemblies) test sets. PartNet ( Mo et al., 2019 ) provides fine-grained semantic parts; following Assembler ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , we train a second model on the Chair, Table, and Lamp categories with the official splits. PartNeXt ( Wang et al., 2025a ) provides 23,519 textured meshes with fine-grained, hierarchical part annotations; following CRAG ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , we train a third model on its training split of 15,563 shapes and evaluate on 3,903 shapes with 2 to 20 parts, extracting one point set per annotated part (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 我们对三个基准进行评价,并对每个基准采用最强公布基准的培训和评价程序,以便报告的数字可以直接比较。 Breaking Bad(Sellán等人,2022年)将组件定义为物理模拟断裂产生的不规则碎片,因此在无语义注释的情况下构成几何重组问题. 继GARF(Li等人,2025年)之后,我们在所有破烂子集上培训一个模型,并在每天(7 872个组件)和Artifact(3 697个组件)的体积受限测试集上加以评价。 PartNet(Mo等人,2019年)提供细纹语义部分;跟随Assembler(Zhao等人,2025年),我们用正式的拆分方式在主席,表,灯等类别上培训第二个模型. PartNEXt(Wang et al.,2025a)为23,519条纹理的元片提供了精细的,分级的部分说明;继CRAG(Jiang et al.,2026)之后,我们训练了第三个模型,其训练分型为15,563个形状,对3,903个形状进行了2至20个部分的评价,根据注释部分抽取一个点集(附录A).

blocks.en: On Breaking Bad, we follow GARF ( Li et al., 2025 ) and report the root mean square rotation error RMSE(R) in degrees and translation error RMSE(T), Part Accuracy (PA), the percentage of parts whose Chamfer distance to the ground-truth placement lies below 0.01, and the Chamfer Distance (CD) between the assembled object and the ground-truth shape. On PartNet, we follow Assembler ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) and additionally report Connectivity Accuracy (CA), whether adjacent parts are correctly connected, and Success Rate (SR), the percentage of assemblies in which all parts satisfy the PA criterion. On PartNeXt, we follow CRAG ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , which adopts the metric definitions of GARF, and report the rotation error (RE) in degrees, the translation RMSE, PA, and CD averaged over all test shapes.
blocks.zh: 关于Breaking Bad,我们跟踪GARF(Li等人,2025年),并报告RMSE(R)在度和翻译错误RMSE(T),Part Accessic(PA)中的根平均方旋转误差,Chamfer与地面真实位置距离在0.01以下的部分的百分比,以及组装对象与地面真实形状之间的Chamfer距离(CD). 在PartNet上,我们遵循Assembler(Zhao等人,2025年)和另外报告连通性准确性(CA),即邻近部分是否正确连通,以及成功率(SR),即所有部分符合PA标准的集会的百分比。 在PartNEXt上,我们遵循CRAG(Jiang等人,2026年),它采用了GARF的度量定义,并报告旋转误差(RE)的度量,翻译RMSE,PA,以及所有测试形状的CD平均值.

blocks.en: The backbone is the Qwen3.5-0.8B language model (24 layers, d = 1024 d=1024 ) with LoRA ( r = 32 r=32 , α = 64 \alpha=64 ) on the query, key, value, and output projections of its attention layers; the point encoder is Point-BERT pretrained on ShapeNet ( G = 64 G=64 neighborhoods of 32 points), and K = S = 64 K=S=64 . We train for 100 epochs (about 10 hours) on 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs with a batch size of 32, using AdamW (learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} ) in bfloat16 with a context limit of 8,192 tokens, and select the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss. The point encoder is frozen for the first 80 epochs, during which the 42.2M trainable parameters comprise the LoRA matrices, the Q-Former, the summary block, and the pose head, and is fine-tuned jointly for the remaining 20 epochs. All loss weights are one, λ R = λ t = λ CD = λ rep = 1 \lambda_{R}=\lambda_{t}=\lambda_{\mathrm{CD}}=\lambda_{\mathrm{rep}}=1 ; the remaining settings are listed in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 4.2 Benchmark Comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.2 基准比较

blocks.en: Table 1 compares LLM2R with representative fractured-reassembly methods on the volume-constrained Everyday and Artifact subsets under the protocol of GARF. LLM2R achieves the lowest translation error on both subsets (RMSE(T) of 0.46 and 0.53, against 1.34 and 1.77 for GARF) and the lowest inference time (0.092 s per instance, against 0.225 s for GARF and 0.185 s for Jigsaw), owing to its single non-autoregressive pass. GARF remains ahead on rotation error, PA, and CD: its rotation error is about half that of LLM2R on both subsets, its CD is lower by a factor of ten on Everyday and three on Artifact, and the PA gap is 2.2 and 3.2 points (94.77% and 93.34% against 92.57% and 90.11%). GARF is pretrained on fracture surfaces and specialized to this setting, whereas LLM2R is a unified architecture without fracture-specific priors; it outperforms all remaining methods on every metric. Qualitative comparisons are given in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 表1比较了LLM2R与具有代表性的碎裂重组方法,这些方法涉及GARF协议下每天的体积受限子集和人工受限子集. LLM2R在两个子集(RMSE(T)为0.46和0.53,而GARF为1.34和1.77)上实现了最低的翻译错误,并且由于单次不自动通过,得出了最低的推断时间(每例0.092,而GARF为0.225,Jigsaw为0.185). GARF在旋转误差,PA,和CD上仍然领先:在两个子集上,它的旋转误差约为LLM2R的一半,其CD在每天的比分上低了10倍,在Artifact上低了3倍,PA的差值为2.2和3.2分(94.77%和93.34%对92.57%和90.11%)。 GARF在断裂面上预受训练,并专门用于这种环境,而LLM2R是一个统一的架构,没有特定断裂前科;它的表现超过了每个度量标准上的所有剩余方法. 定性比较见附录C。

LLM2R attains the highest PA on all three categories (2.2, 2.2, and 8.3 points above the strongest baseline) and the highest SR among the methods that report it, with a large margin on Chair (41.40% against 22.59% for Assembler); its CA is the best on Chair and second or third on Table and Lamp. This gap recurs on PartNeXt, and we discuss it there.

blocks.en: We further evaluate LLM2R on PartNeXt against four recent baselines: GARF ( Li et al., 2025 ) , Rectified Point Flow (RPF) ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , CRAG ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , and Assembler ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) . As reported in Table 4 , LLM2R ranks first on all three pose-centric metrics, with the lowest rotation error (41.12 against 45.12 for CRAG), the lowest translation RMSE (5.24 against 9.13), and the highest PA (67.93% against 65.89%), but trails on CD (6.37 against 2.40 for CRAG and 3.10 for GARF). The two groups of metrics measure different things: RE, RMSE, and PA measure how correctly each part is posed, whereas CD rewards tight surface contact and is dominated by the parts placed far from the surface. We hypothesize that the fracture-oriented pretraining of GARF and the shape prior of CRAG favor locally well-fitted interfaces, which lowers CD even when more parts are misplaced, whereas the few parts that LLM2R misplaces lie far from the surface and inflate CD; the same pattern would explain the CD gap on PartNet.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步对照四个最近的基线对PartNEXt上的LLM2R进行评估:GARF(Li等人,2025年),校正点流动(RPF)(Sun等人,2025年),CRAG(Jiang等人,2026年),以及Assembler(赵等人,2025年)。 如表4所示,LLM2R在所有三个以姿势为中心的衡量标准中排名第一,旋转误差最低(CRAG为41.12,45.12),翻译RMSE为最低(CRAG为5.24,9.13),PA为最高(67.93%,65.89%),但CD的成绩(CRAG为6.37,2.40,GARF为3.10)。 这两组衡量尺度是不同的:RE、RMSE和PA测量每一部分的投放是否正确,而CD则奖励紧凑的表面接触,并以远离表面的部位为主。 我们假设GARF的断裂前训练以及CRAG之前的形状有利于当地适合的接口,即使更多的部件被误用,CD也会降低,而LLM2R错置在远离表面和充气的CD上的少数部分;同样的模式将解释PartNet上的CD缺口。

blocks.en: 4.3 Generalization and Scalability
blocks.zh: 4.3 一般化和可扩展性

blocks.en: To evaluate zero-shot generalization, we train LLM2R, SPAFormer ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , 3DHPA ( Du et al., 2024 ) , and CFPA ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) only on Chair, Table, and Lamp, the PartNet protocol of Section 4.1 , and test them directly on three unseen categories, Bed, Door, and Storage Furniture, without fine-tuning (Table 5 ). The baselines generalize poorly: the highest baseline PA is 10.29%, 15.78%, and 9.13% on the three categories (CFPA in each case), whereas LLM2R reaches 31.03%, 32.49%, and 26.35%, at least 16.7 points higher, together with the lowest CD and the lowest RMSE(R) on every category.
blocks.zh: 为了评价零射一般化,我们将LLM2R、SPAFORmer(徐等人,2025年),3DHPA(杜等人,2024年)和CFPA(张等人,2025年b)的培训只用主席、表和Lamp,即第4.1节的PartNet协议进行,并直接对三个隐蔽类别进行测试,即床、门和储存家具,不作微调(表5)。 基准一般情况不佳:三种类别(每类为CFPA)的基线最高为10.29%、15.78%和9.13%,而LLM2R达到31.03%、32.49%和26.35%,至少高出16.7点,每类最低CD和最低RMSE(R)。

blocks.en: All poses are obtained from a single forward pass over L L tokens (Eq. ( 2 )), and the summary block adds a constant S S tokens irrespective of N N ; with a context limit of 8,192 tokens and K = 64 K=64 , one sequence accommodates up to about 125 parts. Figure 2 reports inference time and accuracy as a function of the part count, using the models of Section 4.1 without retraining. Figure 2 (a) measures the total wall-clock time for 100 PartNet instances per part count when the part blocks are appended to the decoder one at a time. With the key-value cache reused across blocks, the time grows nearly linearly, from 6.33 s at 10 parts (63 ms per instance) to 47.54 s at 100 parts, whereas recomputing the prefix for every block grows superlinearly to 103.37 s. Figures 2 (b) and (c) compare PA on test instances with 30 to 100 parts. On Breaking Bad, GARF is more accurate at 30 fragments (83.61% against 80.13%) but degrades to 24.33% at 100 fragments, whereas LLM2R stays above 57% and reaches 57.85% at 100 fragments, 33.5 points higher. On PartNet, LLM2R and Assembler are close at 30 parts (52.57% against 49.34%), but Assembler collapses to 7.78% at 100 parts while LLM2R retains 36.83%, an improvement of 29.1 points.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: Table 4 ablates the design of LLM2R on the PartNet Chair subset. w/o summary block reads each pose from the last token of its part block, i.e., a plain causal readout; MLP projector replaces the Q-Former with a two-layer MLP applied to each patch descriptor; w/o instruction removes the natural-language content of the prompt while keeping the chat template. Removing the summary block causes the largest drop in PA ( − 7.7 -7.7 points) and raises CD by 2.31, whereas CA is almost unchanged, so the summary mainly improves the absolute placement of parts rather than their local connectivity. The MLP projector lowers PA by 4.9 points and raises CD by 3.5, so the learned queries yield a more useful part representation than a direct projection of the neighborhoods. Removing the instruction lowers PA by 6.1 points and SR by 6.6 points, the largest drop in SR. The geometric tokens, the summary block, and the pose head are identical in both variants, so the difference stems from the instruction tokens alone: the pretrained decoder makes use of the instruction when it processes the geometric tokens. This is the most direct evidence in our study that the language pretraining of the backbone, and not only its capacity, contributes to assembly accuracy.

blocks.en: Parts are presented in the dataset order and the model is not permutation invariant (Section 3.2 ); no predicted pose is fed back into the decoder, so errors cannot accumulate through the predictions, but early parts see a shorter prefix. Table 6 (right) reports the per-position PA of LLM2R on 20-part Chair instances: PA is highest at the first two positions (83.4% and 80.9%), lies between 61.5% and 70.9% from position 5 to 17, and is lowest at positions 18 to 20 (56.4% to 59.6%). The first positions see the shortest prefix yet are the most accurate, so prefix length alone does not explain the trend once the summary states are available; we hypothesize that later positions are more often occupied by small or repeated parts whose placement is intrinsically ambiguous.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We have presented LLM2R, which casts 3D part assembly as causal sequence modeling over geometric part tokens with a LoRA-adapted pretrained decoder-only LLM. A learnable summary block appended after all part tokens aggregates the entire assembly within one forward pass, and a part–summary fusion head conditions every pose on this context at a constant token cost, so that one architecture handles semantic and geometric assembly without autoregressive decoding. LLM2R attains the best part accuracy on PartNet and PartNeXt and the lowest translation error and inference time on Breaking Bad, where only the fracture-specialized GARF is more accurate; its advantage over the baselines grows with the number of parts, and it transfers zero-shot to unseen categories. Ablations show that the summary block contributes most to part accuracy and that the decoder makes use of the language instruction, so the pretrained backbone is used for more than its capacity.
blocks.zh: 我们给出了LLM2R,它将3D部分组装作为因果序列模型,在几何部分符号之上,用一个LORA调整后预装解码器的LLM. 在所有部分符号后附加的可学习摘要块将整个组装集合在一个前传中,而一部分—即总和聚变头条件在这个上下文上以恒定的符号成本,这样一个架构就可以处理语义和几何组装而无需自动解码. LLM2R在PartNet和PartNeXt上获得了最好的部分精度,在Breaking Bad上获得了最低的翻译错误和推断时间,只有断裂专用GARF更准确;它相对于基线的优势随着零件数量的增长而增加,它将零射线转移到了看不见的类别. 缩写显示汇总块对部分精度的贡献最大,解码器使用语言指令,因此预训骨干使用量大于其容量.

blocks.en: LLM2R is not invariant to the part order, and the context window of the decoder bounds the number of parts that can be processed at once (about 125 parts at K = 64 K=64 with a limit of 8,192 tokens). It regresses a single pose per part, so it cannot express several plausible assemblies, and PCA-derived pose targets are ambiguous up to part symmetries, which the Chamfer objective only partly compensates. Its Chamfer distance lags behind hierarchical and fracture-specialized methods, which we attribute to the few parts it misplaces far from the surface. Order-invariant position encodings, larger backbones, and a lightweight geometric refinement of the predicted poses are natural next steps.
blocks.zh: LLM2R对部分顺序不具有偏差,解码器的上下文窗口将可一次性处理的部件数量(K=64 K=64的约125个部件,限制为8,192个令牌)绑定. 它逐一递减了单一的姿势,因此它不能表达几种可信的组合,而由五氯苯甲醚衍生出的姿势目标则模棱两可,以至于部分对称,而Chamfer的目标只是部分补偿。 它的Chamfer距离落后于分级和断裂专用方法,我们将此归因于它错位于远离表面的少数部分. 顺序-不变量位置编码,更大的骨干,以及轻量级几何改进预测的姿势是自然的下一步.

blocks.en: A.1 Assembly Instances from PartNeXt
blocks.zh: A.1 来自NEXt部分的集会实例

blocks.en: PartNeXt provides textured meshes with part masks defined over mesh faces. We adopt the split of CRAG ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , with 15,563 training and 3,903 evaluation shapes that each contain between 2 and 20 parts, and train the PartNeXt model on its training split. For each shape, we read the GLB file, apply the node transformations of the scene graph, and gather the vertices of the faces assigned to each part mask into one point set per part; shapes without usable masks fall back to one part per scene primitive. The point sets of a shape are then normalized jointly, so that the center of the bounding box of the complete object lies at the origin and its longest side has unit length, and each part is stored as a vertex-only OBJ file.
blocks.zh: PartNeXt为纹身的 meshes 提供部分口罩,定义在 mesh 面部. 我们采用CRAG(Jiang等人,2026年)的拆分法,有15 563个培训和3 903个评价形状,每个单元包含2至20个部分,并在培训拆分法上培训PartNEXt模式。 对于每个形状,我们读GLB文件,应用场景图的节点变换,把分配给每个部分面具的面部的顶点集合成每个部分的一个点集;没有可用面具的形状回落到每个场景原始的一个部分. 形状的点集然后共同正常化,这样整个物体的边框中心就位于原位,其最长的侧面有单位长度,每个部分都作为顶点唯一的OBJ文件存储.

blocks.en: The preprocessing above stores the vertices of every part in the normalized object frame and derives the pose target from those coordinates. Before tokenization, each part is expressed in its canonical frame, i.e., its vertices are centered at the centroid and rotated into the principal axes, so that the network observes only the intrinsic geometry of the part and predicts the transform 𝐓 can → obj \mathbf{T}_{\mathrm{can}\to\mathrm{obj}} that returns it to the object frame. The point encoder consumes the vertex set directly; parts with fewer points than required by the grouping are padded by repeating randomly selected points. For PartNet and Breaking Bad, we adopt the official data splits provided by the respective dataset authors and the same canonical-frame construction.

blocks.en: B.1 Model and Training Settings

blocks.en: Table 7 lists the settings of the main configuration. The point encoder follows the Point-BERT configuration with a 12-layer, 384-dimensional Transformer with 6 heads, a discrete vocabulary of 8,192 point tokens, and G = 64 G=64 neighborhoods of 32 points obtained by farthest point sampling and k k -nearest-neighbor grouping; parts with fewer points than required by the grouping are padded by repeating randomly selected points. The encoder is frozen and kept in evaluation mode for the first 80 epochs, so that its normalization statistics do not drift, and is fine-tuned end-to-end for the last 20 epochs. The Q-Former projects each patch descriptor with Linear ⁡ ( 8192 → d ) \mathrm{Linear}(8192\to d) followed by layer normalization, refines K = 64 K=64 learnable queries with N ℓ = 2 N_{\ell}=2 pre-norm layers, each with 8-head self-attention among the queries, 8-head cross-attention to the patch features, and a feed-forward sublayer of width 4 ​ d 4d with GELU, and applies a final layer normalization ( d = 1024 d=1024 ); the ablated MLP projector is Linear ⁡ ( 8192 → d ) → GELU → Linear ⁡ ( d → d ) \mathrm{Linear}(8192\to d)\to\mathrm{GELU}\to\mathrm{Linear}(d\to d) . The pose head comprises the summary block S ( 0 ) ∈ ℝ 64 × 1024 S^{(0)}\in\mathbb{R}^{64\times 1024} , the fusion layer Linear ⁡ ( 2 ​ d → d ) \mathrm{Linear}(2d\to d) with GELU, and two branches of the form Linear ( d → 2048 ) → GELU → Dropout ( 0.05 ) → Linear ( 2048 → 2048 ) → GELU → Linear ( 2048 → ⋅ ) \mathrm{Linear}(d\to 2048)\to\mathrm{GELU}\to\mathrm{Dropout}(0.05)\to\mathrm{Linear}(2048\to 2048)\to\mathrm{GELU}\to\mathrm{Linear}(2048\to\cdot) with 32 outputs (followed by layer normalization) for rotation and 3 outputs for translation. LoRA is applied to the query, key, value, and output projections of the six full-attention layers of the backbone (24 adapted modules) with rank 32, scaling 64, and dropout 0.05. The summary block and the pose head are saved and restored together as one module. blocks.en: The rotation head mixes N a = 32 N_{a}=32 fixed unit quaternions 𝐜 m = ( w , x , y , z ) \mathbf{c}_{m}=(w,x,y,z) . Eight anchors are the signed unit basis vectors ± ( 1 , 0 , 0 , 0 ) \pm(1,0,0,0) , ± ( 0 , 1 , 0 , 0 ) \pm(0,1,0,0) , ± ( 0 , 0 , 1 , 0 ) \pm(0,0,1,0) , and ± ( 0 , 0 , 0 , 1 ) \pm(0,0,0,1) , i.e., the identity and the 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} rotations about the three coordinate axes, each with both quaternion signs. The remaining 24 anchors have exactly two nonzero entries equal to ± 1 2 \pm\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} : those combining the scalar part with one imaginary part represent the ± 90 ∘ \pm 90^{\circ} rotations about the coordinate axes, and those combining two imaginary parts represent the 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} rotations about the six axis bisectors, again with both signs. blocks.en: B.3 Evaluation Procedure
blocks.zh: B.3 评价程序

blocks.en: For every evaluated part, the evaluation script records the geodesic rotation error between the predicted and the target quaternion, the Euclidean translation error, and the squared Chamfer distance between the part transformed by the predicted and by the target pose, computed on at most 2,048 randomly selected points, together with the indicator of whether this distance falls below the PA threshold of 0.01. Inference time is measured with device synchronization around the model call and divided by the number of evaluated instances. These per-part quantities are aggregated into RMSE(R), RMSE(T), PA (threshold 0.01), and whole-object CD following the protocol of GARF, and into CD, PA, CA, and SR on PartNet following the protocol of Assembler, as described in Section 4.1 .
blocks.zh: 对于每个被评价的部分,评价脚本记录了预测和目标之四之间的大地测量旋转误差、欧几利得翻译误差、以及按预测和目标姿势变化的部分之间的平方差差(Chamfer),按最多2 048个随机选择的点计算,以及该距离是否低于巴勒斯坦权力机构0.01门槛值的指标。 推论时间用设备同步在模型调用周围进行测量,除以被评价的例数. 如第4.1节所述,这些每部分的数量被汇总为RMSE(R)、RMSE(T)、PA(阈值0.01)和GARF协议之后的全对象CD,以及Assembler协议之后的CD、PA、CA和PartNet上的SR。
